title: Resize the Alli Rae bath hero (1.3 MB) and the House of Fates path photo (0.5 MB)

verify.note: Fails before the change: bath-hero.webp is 1.3 MB and path-logo.jpg 0.5 MB.

detail: Both files are referenced, so they are resized in place: same path, same aspect ratio, 1600 px wide. bath-hero.webp 2500x3269 (1.32 MB) to 1600x2092 (0.42 MB); path-logo.jpg 1920x1080 (0.51 MB) to 1600x900 (0.15 MB). Next's image optimizer already serves smaller widths, so this trims the source and the fallback, not what a visitor downloads on a normal render.
